title: Onboarding agent
description: RFC 032 onboarding runs, read from onboarding_run. No page text or tenant content is queried.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', "createdAt") AS time,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "fastPathMs") AS p50,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "fastPathMs") AS p95,
  percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "fastPathMs") AS p99
FROM onboarding_run
WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt") AND "fastPathMs" > 0
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', "createdAt") AS time,
  avg(("status" = 'completed')::int) AS completed,
  avg(("status" = 'partial')::int) AS partial,
  avg(("status" = 'failed')::int) AS failed,
  avg(("status" = 'cancelled')::int) AS cancelled
FROM onboarding_run
WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt") AND "status" NOT IN ('queued', 'running')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pages per run (processed and skipped, p50 and p95)
panels.description: Skipped pages were unchanged or cached: the value of incremental crawling.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', "createdAt") AS time,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "pagesProcessed") AS processed_p50,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "pagesProcessed") AS processed_p95,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "pagesSkipped") AS skipped_p50
FROM onboarding_run
WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tokens per run (p50, p95) and budget stops

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', "createdAt") AS time,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "tokensUsed") AS tokens_p50,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "tokensUsed") AS tokens_p95,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE "errorCode" = 'token_budget') AS budget_stops
FROM onboarding_run
WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cost per run (USD): model and enrichment, p50, p95, and total
panels.description: The platform pays both: onboarding spends no AI credits.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', "createdAt") AS time,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "modelCostMicros") / 1e6 AS model_p50,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "modelCostMicros") / 1e6 AS model_p95,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "enrichmentCostMicros") / 1e6 AS enrichment_p50,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "enrichmentCostMicros") / 1e6 AS enrichment_p95,
  sum("modelCostMicros" + "enrichmentCostMicros") / 1e6 AS total
FROM onboarding_run
WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Why runs stopped early
panels.description: deadline, token_budget, stage_failed, access_revoked, background_unavailable, site_unreadable.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce("errorCode", 'none') AS reason, "status", count(*) AS runs
FROM onboarding_run
WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt") AND "status" IN ('partial', 'failed', 'cancelled')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
